Take on a plot

Anyone who lives in the parish can put their name on the waiting list, and plots are offered in the order of the list. When one comes free the secretary writes to you, and you have two weeks to see it and to say yes or no. The rent for a full plot is forty pounds a year, and half of that for a half plot.

Marsh Lane Allotments, 4 Marsh Lane. Open from dawn to dusk.
